description: Authoritative penalty weights for Polaris-EMS Phase 6 multi-objective risk-aware optimizer.

critical_unserved_penalty_per_kwh.rationale: Life support, satcom, freeze protection must dominate operational decisions by 5 orders of magnitude.

thermal_violation_penalty_per_deg_c.rationale: Habitability breach causes pipe freezing and hypothermia; second highest priority.

noncritical_unserved_penalty_per_kwh.rationale: Protects scientific missions and operational loads unless station enters extreme deficit.

reserve_deficit_penalty_per_kw.rationale: Penalizes operating below the dependable reserve margin to buffer sudden gusts and cloud transients.

fuel_cost_per_liter.rationale: Direct fuel preservation objective: minimize liters of polar winter diesel consumed.

generator_startup_penalty.rationale: Starter motor and thermal stress wear cost (equivalent to ~5 liters fuel burn per startup).

battery_wear_penalty_per_kwh.rationale: Throughput cycling wear proxy discouraging unnecessary micro-cycling.

renewable_curtailment_penalty_per_kwh.rationale: Small tie-breaking penalty ensuring renewable power is prioritized over diesel and storage.

terminal_protection.rationale: Prevents optimizer from draining battery storage or reserves at horizon boundary.
